infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kandy Cabs Driver app requires access to your camera to take trip start and end odometer photos for trip verification.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Kandy Cabs Driver app requires your location for real-time trip GPS tracking and odometer evidence stamping.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Kandy Cabs Driver app requires background location tracking while on active trip to update live location for customer and admin.
